item.title: MeitY Secretary Lays Foundation for SAMEER High-Power Microwave Facility at IIT Guwahati
item.description: Union Secretary for the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), S Krishnan, on Tuesday, laid the foundation stone for a new building of the Society for Applied Microwave Electronics Engineering and Research (SAMEER) at the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Guwahati. The facility will house the SAMEER–MeitY Guwahati Centre for High Power Microwave Tube and Component Technology. item.title: Arijit Singh Retires? Fans Shocked at Singer's Social Media Post; He Clarifies
item.description: Renowned Bollywood playback singer Arijit Singh has announced his decision to step away from playback singing, bringing an end to a celebrated chapter of his career. The 38-year-old made the announcement through a social media post on January 27, days after the release of his latest song Maatrubhumi from the film Battle of Galwan. item.title: Gauhati High Court Orders Stay on Eviction Drive at Nellie Tribal Block
item.description: The Gauhati High Court on Tuesday stayed the eviction drive proposed at the tribal block in Nellie, Morigaon district of Assam, and directed the authorities to conduct individual hearings for all persons served with eviction notices. The court instructed the district administration to verify documents on a case-by-case basis and hold personal hearings with each affected individual.
